formats.key: subscribe(address depositToken, uint256 depositAmount, uint256 minimumRwaReceived)
effects: The signer's depositAmount of depositToken is pulled from the signer into the manager, then sent through the Ondo token router (_processSubscription: safeTransferFrom(_msgSender(), address(this), depositAmount)).
The signer's existing allowance to the manager for depositToken is spent by depositAmount.
USDY is minted to the signer: (depositUSD - fee) * 1e18 / USDY price, and the call reverts if this is below minimumRwaReceived (subscribe: IRWALike(rwaToken).mint(_msgSender(), rwaAmountOut)).
A subscription fee read from OndoFees cuts the USDY minted. The minimum is checked after the fee, and the rate limit for the signer's user ID is used up.
formats.shown: "Subscribe with 500 USDC for at least 423.78 USDY+", with fields Deposit Amount (in the deposit token) and Min USDY Received.

findings.title: subscribe: the trailing '+' in interpolatedIntent makes the token read as 'USDY+', a name that looks like another token
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent "Subscribe with {depositAmount} for at least {minimumRwaReceived}+"; case 0 renders "423.7796050114516 USDY+" and the reader was unsure "Whether USDY and USDY+ are the same token"
findings.fix: Remove the '+', e.g. "Subscribe with {depositAmount} for at least {minimumRwaReceived}".

findings.title: subscribe: the fee and the oracle price come from storage, so the screen can only show the enforced minimum
findings.evidence: BaseRWAManager._processSubscription: fee = ondoSubscriptionFees.getAndUpdateFee(...); rwaAmountOut = ((depositUSDValue - fee) * RWA_NORMALIZER) / _getRwaPrice(); the minimum is checked after the fee
findings.fix: None needed. 'Min USDY Received' is the right bound.

cases.notes: 500 USDC out matches Deposit Amount. 441.44 USDY minted to the signer is at least the 423.78 USDY minimum. The reader was unsure whether 'USDY+' is the same token as USDY.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 rwaAmount, address receivingToken, uint256 minimumTokenReceived)
effects: The signer's rwaAmount of USDY is pulled into the manager (spending the signer's allowance) and burned (redeem: transferFrom(_msgSender(), address(this), rwaAmount); burn(rwaAmount)).

receivingToken is sent to the signer: (USDY value - fee) / receivingToken price, and the call reverts if this is below minimumTokenReceived (_processRedemption: safeTransfer(_msgSender(), receiveTokenAmount)).
A redemption fee read from OndoFees cuts the payout, the minimum is checked after the fee, and the rate limit is used up.
formats.shown: "Redeem 746.33 USDY for at least 811.53 USDC+", with fields USDY Amount and Min Receive Amount (in the receiving token).

findings.title: redeem: the trailing '+' in interpolatedIntent makes the payout token read as 'USDC+'
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent "Redeem {rwaAmount} for at least {minimumTokenReceived}+"; case 1 renders "811.526186 USDC+" and the reader noted "screen says 'USDC+' in one line, 'USDC' in another"

findings.title: redeem: the fee and the prices come from storage, so the screen can only show the enforced minimum
findings.evidence: BaseRWAManager._processRedemption: fee = ondoRedemptionFees.getAndUpdateFee(...); receiveTokenAmount = ((redemptionUSDValue - fee) * 10**decimals) / getAssetPrice(receivingToken); the minimum is checked after the fee

cases.notes: 746.33 USDY out (the allowance-spend event is merged into this effect) matches USDY Amount. 845.34 USDC in is at least the 811.53 USDC minimum.

formats.key: subscribeRebasingUSDY(address depositToken, uint256 depositAmount, uint256 minimumRusdyReceived)
effects: The signer's depositAmount of depositToken is pulled into the manager and sent through the Ondo token router (_processSubscription safeTransferFrom).

USDY is minted to the manager, wrapped into rUSDY, and the rUSDY shares are sent to the signer. The call reverts if the rUSDY received is below minimumRusdyReceived (subscribeRebasingUSDY: rusdy.transferShares(_msgSender(), ...); if (rusdyAmountOut < minimumRusdyReceived) revert).
A subscription fee read from storage cuts the amount received, and the rate limit is used up.
formats.shown: "Subscribe with 5000 USDC for at least 4800 rUSDY+", with fields Deposit Amount and Min rUSDY Received.

findings.title: subscribeRebasingUSDY: the trailing '+' makes the token read as 'rUSDY+'
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent "Subscribe with {depositAmount} for at least {minimumRusdyReceived}+"; case 2 renders "4800 rUSDY+" and the reader was unsure "Whether 'rUSDY+' is exactly rUSDY"

findings.title: subscribeRebasingUSDY: the fee and the price come from storage; only the minimum rUSDY can be shown
findings.evidence: BaseRWAManager._processSubscription fee and _getRwaPrice(); USDY_InstantManager.subscribeRebasingUSDY checks rusdyAmountOut against minimumRusdyReceived

cases.notes: 5000 USDC out matches Deposit Amount. 4999.99 rUSDY in is at least the 4800 rUSDY minimum. The intermediate USDY mint and wrap happen inside the manager (signer null).

formats.key: redeemRebasingUSDY(uint256 rusdyAmount, address receivingToken, uint256 minimumTokenReceived)
effects: The signer's rusdyAmount of rUSDY is pulled into the manager (spending the signer's allowance) and unwrapped to USDY, which is burned (redeemRebasingUSDY: rusdy.transferFrom(_msgSender(), address(this), rusdyAmount); unwrap; burn).
receivingToken is sent to the signer for the USDY value minus the fee, and the call reverts if this is below minimumTokenReceived (_processRedemption safeTransfer to _msgSender()).
A redemption fee read from storage cuts the payout, and the rate limit is used up.
formats.shown: "Redeem 1.13 rUSDY for at least 0.96 USDC+", with fields rUSDY Amount and Min Receive Amount (in the receiving token).

findings.title: redeemRebasingUSDY: the trailing '+' makes the payout token read as 'USDC+'
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent "Redeem {rusdyAmount} for at least {minimumTokenReceived}+"; case 3 renders "0.96 USDC+" and the reader was unsure "Whether the token is plain USDC or something called 'USDC+'"

findings.title: redeemRebasingUSDY: the fee and the prices come from storage; only the minimum payout can be shown

cases.notes: 1.1287 rUSDY out (the allowance-spend event is merged into this effect) matches rUSDY Amount. 1.128665 USDC in is at least the 0.96 USDC minimum.
